experiment.description: India Maps Shorts: a claim on the lit map whose answer waits for the payoff as the first line, against the title's question (judged on stayed to watch)
experiment.on: First second (weekly loop, cycle 1, im-claim-hook, on): the first spoken line is a claim about the map whose explanation waits for the payoff, said over the lit state it's about with the state named within 1 s, under 12 words, in Hindi, with no figure (e.g. 'भारत का एक राज्य कभी अलग देश था, उसका अपना राजा था।'); not a question. The title keeps its question; the title's question may be the second line. The payoff gives the answer. Everything else as the recipe says.
experiment.off: First second (weekly loop, cycle 1, im-claim-hook, off): the champion: the first spoken line is the title's question, under 12 words, in Hindi, over the lit state it's about, the state or subject named within 1 s. Everything else as the recipe says.
experiment.why: 0 of 8 Shorts a side have two days of data; day 0 of 7
